spec.description: Sensirion digital humidity and temperature sensor with ±2 %RH / ±0.2 °C accuracy, fully calibrated, I2C interface up to 1 MHz.

pins.note: Supply 2.15–5.5 V; 100 nF decoupling close to the pin.
I2C data. Board default. Pull-up on most breakouts.
Address select: GND → 0x44, VDD → 0x45. Must not float.
Active-low reset; tie high or leave open (internal pull-up).

init_sequence.purpose: Return to default state after power-up
Single shot, clock stretching disabled, high repeatability

warnings: ADDR must be tied to GND or VDD; leaving it floating gives an undefined I2C address.
Each measurement's CRC-8 must be checked; the driver discards frames that fail.
Self-heating: continuous high-repeatability measurements faster than 1 Hz can bias temperature by ~0.1 °C.

fixes.summary: Added `#include <Wire.h>` at the top of the sketch so the Wire I2C object is declared. No pins, commands or formulas were changed.
